name: Hunan Fangsheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Hunan Fangsheng Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. engages in research, develops, produces, and sells traditional Chinese medicine industry and chemical pharmaceutical products in China. The company offers pharmaceutical manufacturing; and provides cardiovascular and cerebrovascular drugs, skeletal muscle system drugs, orthopedic drugs, respiratory drugs, pediatric drugs, neurological drugs, gynecological drugs, and anti-infective drugs.
